title: Literals determined by a path
statement: Let a path on $n$ coordinates have an assignment in $\mathbb F_2$ or no assignment at each coordinate, and a sign-valued terminal output. Associate to it the list containing, for every coordinate in its support, the literal at that coordinate whose required sign is the sign encoding of the path's assigned bit there.
hypotheses_covered: A path with sign-valued terminal output
